id: title:Gilbert09:explain permission denied errors instead of the raw driver error

review.posthog_relevance: Adds human-readable classification and regression tests for a specific Trino permission error, improving error diagnostics and connector reliability.
review.reason: Adds a new error constant, its registration in the exception mapping, and a test case, alongside the implementation of the classification function. This provides a human-readable message for a specific Trino permission error and adds regression coverage, distinguishing it from other access errors. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and user benefit depend on the frequency and severity of this specific Trino error, which is not established by the code alone.
